modules.name: Agent
modules.description: Owns conversational and asynchronous model execution, sessions, task state, tool-call evidence, proposal policy, guarded routing, and Agent-specific authoring contracts; Runtime remains the authority for identity, visible business schema, permissions, workflows, and concrete business effects.
use_when: A PRD needs natural-language interaction, model-assisted reasoning, semi-autonomous multi-step work, structured Agent tasks, governed tool use, or proposals that require human approval
do_not_use_when: The requirement is deterministic CRUD, a fixed workflow, a scheduled trigger, a static report, or a notification delivery with no model reasoning or conversational interaction

categories.name: Agent authoring
categories.description: Author Agent skills, agents, tasks, entrypoints, service identities, and guarded tool allowlists before cross-module references are assembled.

modules.name: Data Exchange
modules.description: Owns durable streaming imports, paged or canonical exports, transfer jobs, chunks, integrity evidence, cancellation, and artifact lifecycle while business providers own row and artifact semantics.
use_when: A PRD needs large or asynchronous data import/export, upload-backed processing, downloadable artifacts, progress tracking, cancellation, retries, or durable transfer evidence
do_not_use_when: The requirement is a small synchronous CRUD request, an on-screen report with no artifact, or direct file storage without import/export job semantics

categories.name: Batch transfer
categories.description: Validate common import/export job envelopes before a Records, Report, or other source owner supplies provider-specific options and content.

modules.name: Identity
modules.description: Authentication, principals, users, organizational identity, roles, permissions, and access-policy configuration.
use_when: The product has authenticated users, service identities, roles, permissions, or organization units
The product requires login, external identity providers, application profile binding, or governed access
do_not_use_when: The requirement only stores a business contact or organization without authentication or access control
The requirement only sends a user-facing message; notification delivery is owned by Notification

categories.name: Identity roles
categories.description: Configure roles, permission grants, and user-role assignments.

modules.name: Integration
modules.description: Connector catalog and provider registry, governed connections and credentials, provider operations, webhooks, external identities, and delivery evidence.
use_when: A PRD requires calling an external provider, receiving verified webhooks, managing connector credentials, synchronizing external identities, or browser push delivery
do_not_use_when: The requirement is entirely internal domain behavior with no provider protocol, external credential, webhook, or delivery boundary

categories.name: Connector connections
categories.description: Discover connector/provider contracts and manage validated connection resources and provider-operation probes.

categories.name: Inbound and push subscriptions
categories.description: Manage webhook and browser push subscriptions and accept provider-authenticated inbound webhooks.

modules.name: Metadata
modules.description: Read-only projection and localization catalog for source-owned definitions, dictionaries, and display text.
use_when: A PRD needs centrally discoverable source-owned definitions, localized display text, localization coverage, or reusable dictionary items
do_not_use_when: The requirement authors business rules or domain definitions owned by another module; Metadata projects those definitions but does not replace their owner

categories.name: Metadata dictionaries
categories.description: Resolve localized items from one projected source-owned dictionary.

modules.name: Notification
modules.description: User-facing notification inboxes, governed templates, recipient preferences, and durable channel-delivery policy.
use_when: A PRD requires user-visible notifications, alerts, read or archive state, recipient preferences, or a durable Inbox
A PRD requires governed notification templates, publication review, digesting, or delivery through one or more channels
do_not_use_when: A workflow only changes internal state and has no user-facing message, alert, or delivery requirement
The requirement is only an external provider callback or data integration without a user notification experience
requirement_signals: email, SMS, push, or in-app delivery

categories.name: Notification delivery governance
categories.description: Configure event types and delivery rules and inspect delivery and Inbox governance metrics.

categories.name: Notification templates
categories.description: Author, preview, review, publish, disable, and restore governed notification templates.

modules.name: Business profile binding
modules.description: Bind an Identity principal to a Runtime business-profile object and its lifecycle semantics.
use_when: A PRD extends authenticated users with business profile fields, claim mappings, profile listings, or profile activation state
do_not_use_when: The requirement only stores a business person without login or only configures authentication roles

categories.name: Profile binding authoring
categories.description: Validate the Identity-to-business-profile binding embedded in a project object's ux.config.

modules.name: Records and Actions
modules.description: Transactional business records and source-owned Action invocation over Runtime schema.
use_when: A PRD needs CRUD, filtered record lists, related records, bulk record jobs, or deterministic business Actions
do_not_use_when: The requirement is analytical aggregation, a human approval graph, or external-provider integration rather than transactional record behavior

categories.name: Action authoring
categories.description: Author Runtime Action metadata while project-owned handlers retain business behavior.

categories.name: Record export
categories.description: Request one authorized record export; Runtime owns delivery and completion handling.

modules.name: Report
modules.description: Source-owned report definitions, authorized analytical execution, materialized snapshots, stable paging, and governed export preparation.
use_when: A PRD requires reusable analytical definitions, aggregates, grouped metrics, stable paged results, report snapshots, or governed exports
do_not_use_when: The requirement is a transactional record list or detail view that can be served directly by the owning business object without analytical definition or export governance

categories.name: Business reports
categories.description: Execute authorized report summaries and Object SQL queries, refresh snapshots, and prepare governed exports.

modules.name: Runtime schema
modules.description: Business-neutral object definitions with embedded fields, relations, validations, and exact-number metadata owned by Runtime Application Schema.
use_when: A PRD needs business objects, typed fields, relations, dictionaries, validation constraints, or exact decimal metadata
do_not_use_when: The requirement only consumes records from an already-defined object or only localizes an owner definition

categories.name: Schema authoring
categories.description: Author and validate complete project object fragments and inspect the embedded field, relation, and dictionary schemas owned by Runtime Application Schema.

modules.name: Scheduler
modules.description: Owns clocks, recurring schedule evaluation, durable trigger claims, retry evidence, runs, and dead letters while downstream modules retain business execution semantics.
use_when: A PRD needs work to run at a future or recurring time, manual scheduled-job execution, bounded catch-up, or durable retry and dead-letter recovery
do_not_use_when: The requirement is an event-driven business reaction, a multi-step human workflow, retention cleanup ownership, or notification delivery without a time schedule

categories.name: Scheduler authoring
categories.description: Read, validate, preview, and simulate published Scheduler definitions.

modules.name: Workflow
modules.description: Published human and system workflow graphs, tasks, decisions, timers, and execution evidence.
use_when: A PRD needs approvals, assignments, branching, human tasks, workflow timers, or durable process state
do_not_use_when: The requirement is one deterministic source-owned Action or a simple recurring clock trigger

categories.name: Workflow authoring
categories.description: Author and validate one complete workflow definition and inspect the embedded graph, node, resolver, trigger, condition, and edge schemas.
